title: Trent Williams could become free agent in $39 million 49ers dilemma

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Trent Williams could become free agent in $39 million 49ers dilemma
sources.description: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reported Tuesday that the two sides are currently “struggling to find a contractual solution” with the star offensive lineman set to carry a $39 million cap hit next season.
